logo:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: production horizontal brand logo for a Chinese B2B AI workspace software named ShiWork.
Primary request: Create one polished, distinctive logo lockup: a compact geometric S symbol on the left and the exact wordmark "ShiWork" on the right.
Brand character: practical, composed, precise, approachable; a tool for moving work from incoming information to finished tasks.
Symbol: a strong minimalist S monogram made of two interlocking broad rounded ribbon segments with a clean negative-space channel, subtle suggestion of connected work steps. Balanced square silhouette; recognizable as a tiny app/sidebar icon. Use one solid teal #087F8C throughout the symbol, with transparency in the negative spaces. No hairline details.
Wordmark: exact case-sensitive text "ShiWork" (S h i W o r k). Refined contemporary geometric sans serif, moderately bold, custom optical spacing, friendly but serious. Solid midnight navy #152734. Icon height approximately 1.15 times the capital-letter height. Horizontal gap approximately half the icon width.
Composition: single horizontal lockup, centered and large, wide 3:1 canvas, generous clear space. Only one logo, no other variants.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no opaque background, no visible checkerboard painted into the image.
Style: perfectly flat, crisp vector-like edges suitable for branding.
Avoid: gradients, shadows, glow, 3D, mockups, decorative sparkles, robot/brain/globe symbols, slogans, extra lettering, frame or watermark.

logo_variants.title: 深底用 Logo
logo_variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Image 1 is the approved ShiWork logo and exact identity reference. Produce its dark-background-use transparent logo variant. Keep the exact S-symbol silhouette, both ribbon pieces, negative-space channel, letter shapes, kerning and horizontal composition from image 1. Change only the symbol color to bright teal #27BCC8 and the exact "ShiWork" wordmark color to pure white #FFFFFF so it reads on midnight navy. Keep the background genuinely transparent alpha, not navy or black. One horizontal lockup only on a wide 3:1 canvas. Flat solid fills, no effects, no gradients, no texture, no shadow, no new text. This is a color variant of the SAME logo, not a redesign.

logo_variants.title: 独立 S 图标
logo_variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Image 1 is the approved ShiWork logo and exact identity reference. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the teal S emblem on the LEFT, retaining the exact outer silhouette, the two broad interlocking ribbon segments, the same negative-space channel and corner radii. Do not include the ShiWork wordmark or any text. Flat single solid teal #087F8C fill. Square canvas with the symbol centered, occupying 72% of height, preserving its original proportions. Truly transparent alpha background and transparent negative spaces. No surrounding tile, no background, no shadow, no gradient, no redesign.
